brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road. In Chapter 18, Jemmy and the prince reach the fair by the river. Build the fair, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each clue from the book and tap the thing it names. Then finish two sentences about the fair.
extra: Add an OptimaEd Rat by the dog. Say what kind of rats Smudge wants Jemmy to catch.
step1: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Press the top button on your right controller and click Models. Put the tent in the square. Put the pot and the potatoes in front. Put the dog and the bear nearby.
step4: Point to the tent and say this out loud. At the fair, the prince learns… I know because…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
